AgentOS.means: Goal, obligations, WorkUnit DAG, scheduler, repair, mutation authority, verifier orchestration, mission persistence, steering
AgentOS.physical: implementation at hcli/<module>.py; ownership package hcli.agentos re-exports the public types (same class objects). Files were not nested under hcli/agentos/ because that would make hcli.goal and hcli.agentos.goal two module objects — the F24 defect again.

Runtime.means: model execution, sessions, context, backends, runtime identity
Runtime.physical: hcli/runtime.py is the Runtime module. A hcli/runtime/ package would shadow it and recreate two identities. Ownership is the module name plus this map.

Doctor.physical: hcli/doctor/ ownership marker; instruments stay tools/doctor_seal.py and tools/gravity_doctor_*.py (nos_pipeline stage 3). Not relocated: moving them would invent a second import identity.

Gravity.physical: hcli/gravity/ ownership marker; product remains tools/gravity_*.py plus hawking crates. Not relocated.

VMCP.physical: hcli/vmcp/ ownership marker; VisionMCP remains the visionmcp/ package. Harnesses insert visionmcp/src (foreign package, not a second hcli name).

Genomes.physical: hcli/genomes/ re-exports MachineGenome from hcli.machine (same class object)
